perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.description: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Killing Wind
enhanced.description: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for an improved duration.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

enhanced.name: Shoot to Loot
enhanced.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves. Increases range.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: Stats for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for an improved duration.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

enhanced.name: Rangefinder
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification, and improves handling. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

enhanced.name: Perpetual Motion
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion for a short duration.

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.description: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

enhanced.name: Archer's Tempo
enhanced.description: Draw time substantially decreases after every precision hit for a longer duration.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

enhanced.name: Impulse Amplifier
enhanced.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, substantially increases reload speed.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.description:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

enhanced.name: To the Pain
enhanced.description:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage greatly increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

enhanced.name: Adrenaline Junkie
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon for an improved duration.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.description: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

enhanced.name: Cornered
enhanced.description: Faster charge time or draw time and increased stability when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.description: Arrows explode after a short delay.

enhanced.name: Explosive Head
enhanced.description: Arrows explode after a short delay. Increases accuracy.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.description: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

enhanced.name: Thresh
enhanced.description: Defeating combatants with this weapon generates an improved small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: One for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: One for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: Adhesive Ordnance
perks.description: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, detonates shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.

enhanced.name: Adhesive Ordnance
enhanced.description: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, has an improved detonation shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

enhanced.name: Sword Logic
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

flavor: It's an unassuming thing, but you'll be amazed at the damage it can do when applied with precision.
